name: plan-cmd-e2e-task-state-empty-verb-target
body: The task_state closure in plan_update_task_clears_target_to_targetless returns empty verb/target strings because the retired task fields are gone and no stored classification remains. Limit: the closure cannot report a verb/target until the operation edge set is reconstructed. Upgrade when task-10/18 land: rebuild task_state from the operation edges instead of the removed fields.
